camel_example: aliyun iot GisQueryDeviceLocation --region cn-hangzhou --ThingList.1.DeviceName mock_device_name --IotInstanceId 'iot-a000013l' --ThingList.1.ProductKey g3r0000Vjta
description_en: Queries the location information of devices
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备位置信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot gis-query-device-location --thing-list ProductKey=g3r0000Vjta DeviceName=mock_device_name --iot-instance-id iot-a000013l --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GisQueryDeviceLocation

element_fields.help_en:
The list of ProductKeys of the products to which the devices belong.
A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a product. You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html.
<notice>The ProductKey and DeviceName of each device must be specified together, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.
</notice>
element_fields.help_zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey列表。
ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice>每个设备的 ProductKey与DeviceName必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
</notice>
element_fields.name: product_key

element_fields.help_en:
The list of device names to query.
<notice>The ProductKey and DeviceName of each device must be specified together, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.
</notice>
element_fields.help_zh:
要查询的设备名列表。
<notice>每个设备的 ProductKey与DeviceName必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
</notice>
element_fields.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
